name: zulfarrak
notes: Zul'Farrak (map 209), written from the world database export of tortoise-wow 5d79486 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/zulfarrak, read with export.sh) and the instance script src/scripts/dungeons/zulfarrak. FIRST-RUN ROUTE: three legs, Antu'sul, Theka the Martyr, Hydromancer Velratha, 1470 yd of navmesh path from the entrance (checked by TestZulfarrakOnNavmesh). Positions come from the export and the navmesh only: NOT checked live yet (no GM-invisible mapping walk was possible when this was written).

Left out of this plan because the driver cannot do them yet (all listed in dungeons/zulfarrak-extra.json or here): (1) Witch Doctor Zum'rah (7271): faction 35 (friendly) until the area trigger 962 (at_zumrah, centre 1909.3 1015.1 11.5, radius 10) fires, and a trigger is only taken from a client packet; the TortoiseBots bots send CMSG_AREATRIGGER only when their master does, and the remote agent stays outside. dungeongen -check -strict would also flag a faction 35 boss. Needs an area_trigger step the agent takes while standing in the instance, or a bot-side order. (2) The stairs event (Sergeant Bly's crew in the cages at the top of the pyramid stairs, three waves of Sandfury trolls, wave 3 summons Nekrum Gutchewer 7796 and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz 7275: they have NO spawn row, the instance script summons them) and (3) Chief Ukorz Sandscalp + Ruuzlu: Ukorz sits behind the End Door (146084), which only Weegli Blastfuse (7607) opens, through his gossip menu after the stairs event; the driver has no gossip/talk step, and a wait inside a step does not fight the waves. (4) Gahz'rilla (7273): summoned by the Gong of Zul'Farrak (141832, lock 459) which needs the Mallet of Zul'Farrak (item 9240, a quest item); skipped unless a Mallet is in the carrier's bags. (5) The Turtle-custom Farraki Arena wing (map y 1300-1440, z about 0: Zel'jeb the Ancient 62495, Sandfury Ritualists 62500, Champion Razjal 62498 / Juthza 62497 / Kath'zen 62496, farraki_arena.cpp): not on any route here.

No team gate is needed: every mob of the route is hostile to both teams (factions 37, 16 and 107); the friendly NPCs (Sergeant Bly's crew faction 35, Elder Wildmane 15578 faction 35 npc_flags 3 at the gong, the three arena NPCs) are not in any pull group.

The End Door (146084, 1854.5 1142.9 16.1) is in the middle of the navmesh route between the graveyard (Zum'rah) and the gong: the navmesh has no doors, so the shortest Theka -> Velratha path (562 yd) walks THROUGH the closed door. The Velratha leg therefore starts at (1676.1 833.5), west of the junction at (1645 909), and goes north by the west road (366 yd from the junction); the bots never need the door.

Entry: the game has no game_tele inside Zul'Farrak (game_tele 160 "Zul'Farrak" is outside, map 1 at -6801.2 -2893.0 9.0, 28 yd from the portal), so there is no entrance_tele: a remote run enters by walking the lead bot into area trigger 924 (map 1, centre -6773.5 -2889.8 15.1, radius 20), the 'walk' method (not verified live for bots whose master is outside the group). outside_tele "farrak" is a partial match that only game_tele 160 has, for prepare.fresh.

Scarabs (7269, 68 spawns, faction 15) swarm near Theka and are in every leg's skip list; so are the two rare elites Sandarr Dunereaver (10080) and Zerillis (10082), which sit on the road at 1661 900 and 1708 881.

legs.name: antusul
notes: Fourteen pull groups on the road from the entrance east (Sandfury Shadowcasters 5648, Blood Drinkers 5649, Witch Doctors 5650, Soul Eater 7247, the Sul'lithuz Sandcrawler 8095 on the ramp) to Antu'sul (8127, faction 107) in the south-east corner. Antu'sul summons two Sul'lithuz Broodlings (8138, 120 s) on aggro, casts Earthgrab Totem / Healing Ward, heals itself at 20%/60% and calls Antu'sul's Minion at 75% and 25% (creature_ai_events 812701-812709). The three Sul'lithuz Hatchlings (8130, faction 16) stand 8-12 yd from it and are the last pull group.

legs.name: theka
notes: Theka the Martyr (7272) stands by his table (Tablet of Theka 142715, a quest object); at 30% health he casts Theka Transform (11089) and goes on fighting. The pair next to him (Soul Eater 7247 + Blood Drinker 5649, patrolling) is the one pull group. The 33 scarabs around him are skipped (7269).

legs.name: velratha
notes: Hydromancer Velratha (7795) wanders a little in her pool room (movement type 2, no creature_ai): a pack of five (5649, 5650, 7246, 5650, 5649) stands 25 yd south of her and a single Blood Drinker (5649) 16 yd south-east. The Gong of Zul'Farrak (141832) stands at 1650.9 1171.9 10.9, 26 yd from the 1648 1152 group: the party must not use it (no Mallet). Gahz'rilla's pit is at 1664.7 1187.7 -2.9, off the navmesh.
